bugs_found: fx_convert quantizes the exchange rate before multiplying, which can materially misprice conversions; rounding should usually happen on the final amount, if at all.
transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal like the other functions, so float inputs can raise TypeError during Decimal arithmetic and Receipt.amount may have an inconsistent type.
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate years/months with int(...), so fractional inputs are accepted but produce surprising incorrect results.
